modes.name: ChatMode
modes.description: General LiteraryGiant conversation and planning mode.
modes.expected_output_format: concise plan, questions only when blocked

modes.name: CodeMode
modes.description: Modify LiteraryGiant code through a Codex-core adapter.

modes.name: ReferenceMode
modes.description: Retrieve and abstract reusable structures from reference libraries.
modes.expected_output_format: abstracted patterns with source ids and no copied prose

modes.name: DirectionExpansionMode
modes.description: Expand a one-line story direction into a commercial fiction seed.
modes.expected_output_format: genre, protagonist, conflict, hooks, selling points

modes.name: OutlineMode
modes.description: Create volume and chapter outlines with hooks, reversals, payoff, and pacing.
modes.expected_output_format: positioning, premise, arcs, volume outline, chapter outline, risks

modes.name: WorldbuildingMode
modes.description: Design world rules, power systems, factions, geography, resource economy, and limits.
modes.expected_output_format: rules, factions, geography, resources, hierarchy, taboo, cost

modes.name: CharacterMode
modes.description: Design protagonists, antagonists, allies, relationships, motivations, and arcs.
modes.expected_output_format: character table, desire, wound, lie, growth, relationship tension

modes.name: PlotMode
modes.description: Build plot arcs, conflict escalation, reversals, setup-payoff, and chapter boundaries.
modes.expected_output_format: arc map, conflict ladder, chapter beats, hooks, payoff ledger

modes.name: ChapterWritingMode
modes.description: Draft chapters from outline and memory while preserving momentum and continuity.
modes.expected_output_format: chapter goal, scene plan, prose draft, hook, memory updates

modes.name: RevisionMode
modes.description: Revise existing story artifacts for clarity, pacing, consistency, and style.
modes.expected_output_format: revision diagnosis, patch plan, revised artifact

modes.name: ConsistencyCheckMode
modes.description: Find contradictions in characters, setting, timeline, power scale, relationships, and causality.
modes.expected_output_format: contradiction list, severity, file references, repair suggestions

modes.name: CriticMode
modes.description: Evaluate output quality and propose targeted improvements.

modes.name: MemoryUpdateMode
modes.description: Update durable story memory, relationship facts, timeline, and known issues.
